title: The method gate checks that the CLI admits the workspace
summary: method-gate.mjs asks the CLI to validate the workspace before it runs the reports, and evaluates only a workspace reported as admitted. A refused workspace, any other status, or a validate that cannot run leaves both rules not evaluated and names the error codes, and the JSON carries admission. A child's printed time limit is at least one second. The README says this catalogue's own CI runs the gate as a report, and that a repository that ignores its lock restores it first.
